name: Brett M Sherman

bio.statement: The Happy Valley city council page lists Sherman in Council Position 3 with a term expiring December 31, 2026.
Sherman's pamphlet statement says he has served as a Happy Valley city councilor for twelve years.
bio.excerpt: For twelve years I’ve been honored to serve as your City Councilor

bio.statement: Sherman's pamphlet statement lists investment roles at Lucid Advisors, Norwest Bank and Piper Jaffray.
bio.excerpt: Director-Investment Consulting, Lucid Advisors; Institutional Investment Manager, Norwest Bank;

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Sherman says he would encourage economic growth by supporting local businesses and job creation.
positions.excerpt: Encourage economic growth by supporting our local businesses and job creation opportunities.

positions.statement: Sherman's pamphlet statement lists providing safe and effective schools.
positions.excerpt: Providing safe and effective schools to empower our next generation.

positions.statement: Sherman's pamphlet statement says he would manage city growth to maintain a small-town feel while improving services.
positions.excerpt: Prudently manage city growth to maintain our “small-town feel” while improving services.
